data.title: The Pond on a Rainy Day
poemLines: The grey clouds dance across the sky,
The sleepy pond is calm and wide,
And happy frogs begin to slide.

figurativeInstances.text: The grey clouds dance across the sky,

data.poem:
The grey clouds dance across the sky,
The sleepy pond is calm and wide,
The buzzing dragonflies wave goodbye,
And happy frogs begin to slide.
